description: A composite figure of sixteen secondary-electron (SE) SEM micrographs of the 19Al (Fe-35Mn-19Al-5Cu at.%) low-density steel after aging, arranged in four rows and four columns; each panel is labelled top-left with its aging temperature and time. Temperatures are 525 °C, 550 °C and 575 °C (each with 1, 3, 6 and 10 h), then 600 °C - 1 h, 600 °C - 6 h, 625 °C - 1 h and 650 °C - 1 h in the bottom row. All scale bars are 50 µm except 550 °C - 3 h (100 µm); 10 µm insets appear in 525 °C - 1 h, 525 °C - 10 h, 625 °C - 1 h and 650 °C - 1 h. Green arrows label β-Mn, blue arrows label α-Mn (in the 525 °C - 1 h and 525 °C - 10 h insets), red text marks 'Untransformed α' (550 °C - 6 h, 575 °C - 3 h) and magenta text marks 'New precipitates' (550 °C - 10 h, 575 °C - 10 h, 600 °C - 6 h, 650 °C - 1 h). At 525 °C the α matrix stays almost featureless even after 10 h; from 550 °C β-Mn appears, first decorating α grain boundaries and as short rods inside grains, until at 550 °C - 10 h the matrix is β-Mn with fine new precipitates. The sequence demonstrates that the α→β-Mn transformation of this highest-Al alloy is thermally activated and slow.

observations.observation: The figure is a 4×4 grid of sixteen SE-SEM micrographs, each labelled top-left with an aging temperature and time, all of the 19Al alloy.
Green 'β-Mn' labels with arrows mark the β-Mn phase in the 525 °C - 6 h and 525 °C - 10 h panels and in the 550 °C - 1 h, 550 °C - 10 h, 575 °C - 6 h and 600 °C - 1 h panels.
Blue 'α-Mn' labels appear only in the 10 µm insets of the 525 °C - 1 h and 525 °C - 10 h panels.
Red text 'Untransformed α' with arrows is printed in the 550 °C - 6 h and 575 °C - 3 h panels.
Magenta text 'New precipitates' with arrows is printed in the 550 °C - 10 h, 575 °C - 10 h, 600 °C - 6 h and 650 °C - 1 h panels.
Scale bars are 50 µm in most panels but 100 µm in the 550 °C - 3 h panel, and four panels contain 10 µm insets.
At 525 °C the microstructure remains almost featureless α even at 10 h, with no clear β-Mn; β-Mn becomes visible from 550 °C onward, first as a bright grain-boundary network in 550 °C - 3 h.
The 550 °C - 10 h panel shows an apparently fully transformed β-Mn matrix containing fine 'New precipitates' visible in the 10 µm inset.
The caption states the images are secondary electronic (SE) images of the 19Al alloy after different aging treatments.
The citing text states the α matrix of the 19Al alloy had fully transformed into β-Mn after 10 h at 550 °C, versus 6 h for the 17Al alloy.
The citing text states β-Mn primarily precipitated along α grain boundaries with a small amount of short rod-shaped β-Mn within α grains.
The citing text states that at 600 °C and above the α had almost completely transformed into β-Mn in both 17Al and 19Al alloys after just 1 h of aging.
The citing text states numerous fine precipitates distributed within the β-Mn were observed after the α matrix had fully transformed into β-Mn.

The citing text states that increasing Al content slowed the precipitation kinetics of β-Mn relative to the 15Al and 17Al alloys, and that at 575 °C the 19Al alloy showed β-Mn only along α grain boundaries even after 3 h.

subfigures.description: Nearly featureless α matrix with faint grain boundaries; inset (10 µm) labelled α-Mn with two arrows pointing to twin-like lamellae. 50 µm scale bar.
Uniform α matrix, no visible precipitate; 50 µm scale bar.
α matrix with a few fine particles; green β-Mn arrow and blue α-Mn arrow. 50 µm scale bar.
Mostly unreacted α with sparse β-Mn (green label); inset (10 µm) labelled α-Mn. 50 µm scale bar.
Smooth α matrix; inset (10 µm) with green β-Mn arrow indicating a grain-boundary precipitate. 50 µm scale bar.
Bright β-Mn network along α grain boundaries with additional intra-granular short rod-shaped precipitates; one complete frame shown with a 100 µm scale bar.
Partially transformed structure with red 'Untransformed α' label and arrows; 50 µm scale bar.
β-Mn matrix (green label) with magenta 'New precipitates' arrowed; inset (10 µm) shows the fine precipitates. 50 µm scale bar.
α matrix with well-developed grain-boundary network of β-Mn; 50 µm scale bar.
Red 'Untransformed α' label with arrows to residual α regions; 50 µm scale bar.
Featureless, largely β-Mn matrix marked with green β-Mn label; 50 µm scale bar.
β-Mn matrix with magenta 'New precipitates' arrows; 50 µm scale bar.
Matrix with green β-Mn label and arrows to fine features; 50 µm scale bar.
Magenta 'New precipitates' label with arrows within the transformed matrix; 50 µm scale bar.
Low-contrast matrix with a 10 µm inset (detail barely legible); 50 µm scale bar.
Magenta 'New precipitates' label with arrows; 10 µm inset enlargement (interior detail faint). 50 µm scale bar.

650 °C - 1 h panel: interior detail of the 10 µm inset is faint and only partially readable
500–525 °C panels: individual β-Mn precipitates at 525 °C - 6 h and - 10 h are not clearly distinguishable from image noise
arrow targets in 575 °C - 6 h and 600 °C - 1 h are ambiguous as to which feature is being labelled
